senses.gloss: नैगम (I) a. (f. मी) Relating to or occurring in the Veda.

नैगम (II) m. 1. An interpreter of the sacred writings; 2. an उपनिषद् q.v.; 3. a means, an expedient; 4. prudent conduct; 5. a citizen, a townsman, a trader, a merchant, धाराहारोपनयनपरा नैगमाः सानुमंतः Vikr.iv.
नैगम (I) a. (f. मी) Relating to or occurring in the Veda.
